name: Windows Process Creation Events Include Command Line
description:
Ensures process creation audit events (4688) include the full command line (ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled = 1), which is essential to investigate script-based and living-off-the-land attacks.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit" /v ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

remedy.command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit" /v ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null; reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit" /v ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled
